data.name: About.Privacy.Statement
data.value: Shiftwall sends no data. It works completely offline.

data.name: About.Privacy.Details
data.value: No telemetry, analytics, online crash reports or automatic updates. Configurations are processed in memory and never written to logs. The only network feature (Backup from LAN page) is off by default and runs only when you start it.

data.name: Anonymize.Intro
data.value: Masks what identifies you before you send a configuration to a colleague or to support. The same value always gets the same alias, so the file stays readable. The map that reverses it is saved only on this PC, encrypted with your password.

data.name: Anonymize.MapHelp

data.name: Anonymize.SaveOrder

data.name: Lan.Intro
data.value: Downloads the configuration backup from a FortiGate on your local network through its REST API. This is the only Shiftwall feature that uses the network, and only when you press Download.

data.name: Lan.DisabledBody
data.value: By default Shiftwall never opens a network connection. Enable this feature only if you want to download backups directly from a FortiGate: you will need a REST API administrator token (FortiOS: System › Administrators › REST API Admin).

data.name: Lan.EnableConfirm
data.value: Enable the LAN feature? Shiftwall will connect to a FortiGate only when you press Download, only to private IP addresses, and will never store the token.

data.name: Lan.HostInvalid
data.value: Enter a private IP address (10.x, 172.16-31.x, 192.168.x or IPv6 fc00::/7). Host names are not accepted.

data.name: Lan.TokenHelp
data.value: Kept only in memory for this download, then cleared. Never written to disk.

data.name: Lan.FortiOs801
data.value: The FortiGate runs FortiOS 8.0.1 or later

data.name: Lan.BackupPasswordHelp
data.value: From FortiOS 8.0.1 a backup must protect its secrets: they are encrypted with this password and the rest stays readable. You will need it to restore the file.

data.name: Lan.CertificateConfirm

data.name: Lan.Outcome.NotFound

data.name: Lan.Outcome.NotAConfiguration
data.value: The answer is not a FortiOS backup (on FortiOS 8.0.1 and later tick the option and set a backup password).

data.name: Lan.Outcome.NetworkError

data.name: Lan.Saved
data.value: Saved: {0}. You can now open it in the other tools.

data.name: Lan.SafetyBody
data.value: Only private IP addresses are accepted, so no DNS query is made and nothing leaves your network. No proxy is used and redirects are not followed. A certificate not trusted by Windows is used only after you confirm its fingerprint; the fingerprint (not secret) is remembered for that device. The token and the backup password are never saved and are cleared after each attempt.

data.name: Lan.Sources
data.value: Endpoint /api/v2/monitor/system/config/backup: FortiOS Administration Guide ("Using APIs", "REST API administrator") and Fortinet Community technical tips. Fortinet's full API reference (FNDN) requires an account, so the HTTP method is POST with a fallback to GET.
